caption: The drawing depicts nine circular objects arranged in a loose oval with an additional smaller circular and bar-shaped object positioned centrally below the largest object. The objects are numbered 1, 1a, 2, 3, 4, 4a, 5, 6, 7, and 7a. The objects are all drawn in shades of grey on a light beige or off-white background. Each object appears to be a button or coin-like form, showing details such as rims, indented centers, holes, and decorative patterns or insignias. The central item, labeled “4”, is the largest and is located in the middle of the composition, and below it is a bar with a small circular shape attached, labeled “4a”. The other objects—numbered 1, 1a, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, and 7a—are smaller and distributed around the central object at approximately even intervals. The objects show differences in shading and texture, and some contain distinct patterns or designs. The labels are written in small, neat script next to each item. The entire composition is presented on an otherwise blank background.
title: Buttons
